verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's docs show that nearly every core capability (agents, extraction, stealth, captcha-solving, profiles, recordings, MCP tool access) is exposed via API/SDK calls, consistent with an API-first product where the UI is largely a thin dashboard over these same primitives. However, there is no explicit statement that every dashboard feature has an API equivalent, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec (404s across candidate paths), so the full surface of the API cannot be independently verified against the UI. missing for 10: explicit UI-vs-API feature parity statement, publicly discoverable OpenAPI/API reference confirming full coverage.
